title: Relay Pumping: LDH Supply to Attack Engine

scene.description: Engine 181 is supplying Engine 183 through 4-inch LDH. For these training problems, use C = 0.2, the stated elevation, and the stated desired receiving-engine intake pressure.

problems.title: Relay Pumping: LDH Supply to Attack Engine
problems.question: Engine 181 is at the hydrant supplying Engine 183 through 800 ft of 4-inch LDH. Engine 183 needs 500 GPM delivered. The lay gains 30 ft in elevation and Engine 183 needs 20 PSI residual intake pressure. Using C = 0.2 and the training approximation of 0.5 PSI/ft, what discharge pressure should Engine 181 pump?
problems.inputLabel: Your relay pump discharge pressure answer
formulaBreakdown: Relay PDP = relay FL + elevation + desired intake pressure.
problems.instructorExplanation: This is a relay supply problem; nozzle pressure is not added at the supply engine.
problems.explainMistake: Use the full 800-ft relay lay, the stated 30-ft rise, and the stated 20 PSI desired intake pressure.

problems.title: Relay Pumping: 500 GPM Through 1000 Feet of LDH
problems.question: Engine 181 is supplying Engine 183 through 1000 ft of 4-inch LDH at 500 GPM. The lay gains 30 ft and Engine 183 needs 20 PSI residual intake pressure. Using C = 0.2 and 0.5 PSI/ft as the training elevation approximation, what discharge pressure should Engine 181 pump?
problems.inputLabel: Your relay pump discharge pressure answer
problems.instructorExplanation: The longer 1000-ft relay segment increases the friction loss to 50 PSI.
problems.explainMistake: Use the full 1000-ft relay lay in this variation; do not reuse the 800-ft distance from another question.

problems.title: Relay Pumping: 600 GPM Through 800 Feet of LDH
problems.question: Engine 181 is supplying Engine 183 through 800 ft of 4-inch LDH at 600 GPM. The lay gains 30 ft and Engine 183 needs 20 PSI residual intake pressure. Using C = 0.2 and 0.5 PSI/ft as the training elevation approximation, what discharge pressure should Engine 181 pump?
problems.inputLabel: Your relay pump discharge pressure answer
formulaBreakdown: Using the app's nearest-5-PSI operating answer, set 95 PSI.
problems.instructorExplanation: The exact arithmetic is about 93 PSI; this training scenario uses a 95 PSI operating answer within the stated tolerance.
problems.explainMistake: Do not call 95 PSI the exact arithmetic result. The calculated value is about 93 PSI and 95 PSI is the rounded operating answer.

problems.title: Relay Pumping: 500 GPM Through 800 Feet of LDH
problems.question: Engine 181 is supplying Engine 183 through 800 ft of 4-inch LDH at 500 GPM. The lay gains 50 ft and Engine 183 needs 20 PSI residual intake pressure. Using C = 0.2 and 0.5 PSI/ft as the training elevation approximation, what discharge pressure should Engine 181 pump?
problems.inputLabel: Your relay pump discharge pressure answer
problems.instructorExplanation: This variation changes only the elevation rise; the relay-hose friction loss remains 40 PSI.
problems.explainMistake: Use the 50-ft rise stated in this question rather than the 30-ft rise from the other variations.
